scenes.title: why: two to the x is e to the x, stretched sideways

voiceover.text: The key is to write two as a power of e. The natural log of two is the power you raise e to, to get two. So two is approximately e to the point six nine three. Exactly, two to the x is e raised to the power x times the natural log of two. So two to the x is just e to the x, stretched sideways. Watch this tangent triangle on e to the x, at height two. Now let's prove it for any positive base a. The natural log of a is the power that turns e into a, so a equals e to the natural log of a. So a to the x is e raised to a new power, x times the natural log of a. Call that power u. The base is fixed, so the natural log of a is just a number, and d u by d x is the natural log of a.
